requirements.title: RESHAPE argument restrictions
requirements.definition: SOURCE shall be an array, source size shall be sufficient with PAD absent or size zero, SHAPE shall be a rank-one integer array of positive size less than 16 with no negative element, PAD shall match SOURCE type and type parameters, and ORDER shall be an integer array with SHAPE's shape and a permutation of 1 through n.

pending.RESHAPE-SOURCE-array: Positive source controls use rank-one and rank-two SOURCE arrays; source-control mutation uses a scalar SOURCE without claiming a diagnostic facet.
pending.RESHAPE-SOURCE-size-sufficient-without-P: Positive controls use sufficient SOURCE size without PAD and shorter SOURCE with nonempty PAD; mutations omit PAD for an undersized SOURCE and use size-zero PAD without enough SOURCE elements, with no diagnostic facet claimed.
pending.RESHAPE-SHAPE-rank-one-integer-positive-: Positive controls use SHAPE arrays [2,3] and [2,2,1]; mutations use scalar SHAPE, real SHAPE, zero-size SHAPE, and size 16 SHAPE without claiming diagnostic facets.
pending.RESHAPE-SHAPE-elements-nonnegative: Positive controls include zero extent [0,3] and positive extents [2,3]; mutation uses SHAPE [2,-1] without claiming a diagnostic facet.
pending.RESHAPE-PAD-same-type-parameters: Positive controls use integer PAD for integer SOURCE and character PAD matching length and kind; mutations use real PAD and mismatched character length without claiming diagnostic facets.
pending.RESHAPE-ORDER-integer-same-shape-permuta: Positive controls use ORDER [1,2] and [2,1]; mutations use real ORDER, wrong-shape ORDER, duplicate element [1,1], and out-of-range element [1,3] without claiming diagnostic facets.

requirements.title: RESHAPE pads by cycling PAD elements
requirements.definition: After SOURCE elements are exhausted, RESHAPE uses PAD elements in array element order and repeats additional copies of PAD as necessary.

pending.RESHAPE-uses-PAD-after-SOURCE: Use SOURCE [1,2], PAD [7,8], and SHAPE [2,2]; assert trailing result positions contain 7 and 8, with a sufficient-SOURCE companion proving PAD is not always used.
pending.RESHAPE-repeats-PAD-as-needed: Use SOURCE [1], PAD [7,8], and SHAPE [2,3]; assert the padded tail is 7,8,7,8,7 in the selected order, then mutate PAD order.
